text:
taylor: Quick heads-up — ran the 60d hosted demand vs committed capacity sweep. Shortfall looks real in eu-west1 from week 5 onward.

michael: paste the numbers?

taylor: total hosted demand +35% QoQ, committed GPU-hours flat. rough gap ~420 g5-equivalent GPUs by week 7.

anya: is that normalized for burst credits/spot? any headroom?

taylor: included burst (2 weeks) and spot conversion ~15% effective. headroom only in us-west for now.

finance: any immediate billing risk? do we hit overage in current month?

taylor: if demand follows current trend we hit overage week 6; estimated incremental cloud spend ~$180k/month if we don't top up commits.

ops-bot: Current reserved snapshot:
```
region         reserved_g5  active_usage  buffer
us-west        1200         980           220
eu-west         300         680          -380
ap-southeast    150         140            10
```

samir: can't move us-west capacity to eu due to contracts, but we can accelerate a EU commit for next 30d. what's the lead time?

leslie: typical commit lead is 10 business days for procurement / cloud sales. faster with a temporary commitment swap with finance sign-off.

michael: options: 1) short-term burst on EU spot (higher variance), 2) buy 6mo EU reserved (cheaper long-term), 3) traffic shaping + rate-limit heavy customers (product impact). tradeoffs?

anya: can we run a scenario where we: a) buy 400 g5-eu reserved starting wk6 b) apply 10% batching+cache gains -> show token cost delta

taylor: running now. CLI call:
```
rwd infra forecast --horizon 90 --regions eu-west,us-west --scenario "400-eu-reserved +10pct-batching" --output json
```

ops-bot: Forecast job queued (job_id: fcast-2148200000-42). ETA ~12m.

finance: schedule an emergency sync with cloud sales if the fast-proc path is needed. I can join.

samir: I'll draft the purchase options and accelerated PO path. tagging @leslie for procurement contacts.

leslie: thanks. if the forecast confirms >300 gap, we'll need a leadership thumbs-up for spend.

taylor: update when job finishes, will post the JSON summary here.

ops-bot: Forecast job completed. Summary: gap reduced to 60 g5-equivalent after proposed purchase and batching. Estimated monthly incremental cost vs. overage path: reserved path saves ~35% over payg. full report: https://redwood.internal/reports/fcast/fcast-2148200000-42

michael: good signal. let's prepare a 30/90 day plan and present to infra review tomorrow.

anya: noted. I'll start a short-run benchmarking to validate the 10% batching gain assumption.

taylor: cool, tagging this thread for follow-up in next infra sync. :thumbsup:
